sources.title: GPT-4.1 Mini model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact-model documentation gives ID gpt-4.1-mini, default snapshot gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, 1,047,576-token context, text and image inputs, text output, file uploads and function calling. It explicitly describes operation without a reasoning step and marks the model deprecated. It discloses no parameter count or architecture.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API
sources.evidence: Dated April 14, 2025; explicitly launches GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini and GPT-4.1 nano in the API that day. Groups mini within the GPT-4.1 family and supplies mini-specific vision and function-calling benchmark columns. The article calls mini a small model but supplies no parameter count or architecture.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: PDF file input for vision-capable models is processed into extracted text and page images. Responses and Chat Completions accept PDFs; this is an API file format, not a separate learned modality. Read with the exact mini model page confirming image input and file uploads.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: The current agreement, effective January 1, 2026, covers API services, grants limited access and use, and reserves service IP rights. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification, not a named checkpoint license or the claim that these exact terms applied at April 2025 launch.

sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss
sources.evidence: Complete indexed primary article dated August 5, 2025 states that gpt-oss were OpenAI’s first open-weight language models since GPT-2, corroborating closed weights for the April 2025 mini release. Direct page retrieval timed out and urllib returned 403; the indexed article was readable. Its numerical counts and Transformer/MoE architecture describe gpt-oss only and are not transferred.

sources.title: OpenAI deprecations
sources.evidence: October 14, 2026 notice lists GPT-4.1 mini (gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14) for January 14, 2027 API shutdown. This documents service lifecycle; it does not change the first-release date or establish endpoint operation through a live request.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Later system card downloaded and text searched as a cross-model disclosure check. Its text references GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1-nano, but does not disclose GPT-4.1 mini parameter counts, active counts, or architecture. No GPT-5 or nano specifications are transferred to mini.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-4.1 mini record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead reviewed: it labels the family gpt-mini and includes the promotional description and PDF input. Its specifications are independently checked against the exact OpenAI model documentation; this catalog is not primary verification.

sources.title: Training Agents to Self-Report Misbehavior
sources.publisher: Bruce W. Lee, Yueh-Han Chen and Tomek Korbak; linked by OpenAI Alignment
sources.evidence: Later training paper linked from OpenAI Alignment names GPT-4.1 mini among models trained through public fine-tuning APIs. Its model setup and comparison sections do not disclose mini parameter counts or architecture. Prompted scratchpad usage is separate from dedicated internal reasoning-mode support.

name.note: Retain official launch styling; current documentation capitalizes Mini. This record is the unpinned API name, whose documented target is the April 14, 2025 snapshot.

developer.note: The official announcement and model documentation identify OpenAI.

family.note: The announcement explicitly places mini in the GPT-4.1 family; gpt-mini groups variants across generations and is not the release family.

release_date.note: Explicit first API launch date for mini; later ChatGPT availability and current deprecation do not replace the first release.

open_weights.note: Mini is released as a hosted OpenAI API model; the later first-open-weights-since-GPT-2 statement corroborates that the April 2025 release did not distribute weights.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary service/model classification. No public downloadable-checkpoint license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: No mini-specific total count was found in the official launch/model documentation or later system-card check. Exact-model searches for later first-party parameter disclosures yielded no supporting count. Small/mini labels and price do not quantify parameters.

active_parameters_b.note: No mini-specific active-parameter count was found in the reviewed primary sources or later-report search. Do not equate total with active or infer expert routing.

architecture.note: No exact-mini architecture disclosure found in the reviewed model documentation, launch, later system card, or first-party training/interpretability searches. The GPT name and disclosures about GPT-4, GPT-4.1, nano or gpt-oss do not establish mini’s structure. Later self-report training research also names mini but does not establish its structure.

context_window.note: Exact published base-model context limit. The launch’s one-million wording is rounded; the separate 32,768 maximum output limit is not the context length.

modalities.note: Native model inputs are text and image and output is text. Retain PDF under the catalog’s supported API-file convention: PDFs become extracted text plus page images, not a separate learned modality. No native audio/video input or image output is claimed.

reasoning.note: Exact-mini documentation explicitly says it operates without a reasoning step. This field denotes dedicated reasoning-mode behavior, not an inability to solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Exact-mini model documentation explicitly lists function calling; the launch also publishes mini-specific function-calling evaluations.

description.value: GPT-4.1 mini accepts text and images and generates text, with a 1,047,576-token context window and function calling.
description.note: Replace vague price/speed and structured-extraction marketing language with directly documented input, output, context and function-calling facts.

patch.description: GPT-4.1 mini accepts text and images and generates text, with a 1,047,576-token context window and function calling.
patch.notes: The unpinned gpt-4.1-mini name currently documents gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 as its default snapshot. The first API release was April 14, 2025. As reviewed October 27, 2026, OpenAI marks the model deprecated and schedules API removal for January 14, 2027; no live endpoint request was made. PDF inputs are processed into text and page images. Parameter counts remain undisclosed and exact-mini architecture remains unverified in the reviewed primary sources, including later self-report training research.

summary: Correct family to GPT-4.1, add proprietary license classification and primary sources, and replace promotional description. Confirm April 14, 2025 release, exact 1,047,576 context, text/image plus API PDF input, text output, no dedicated reasoning step, and function calling. Total/active counts and architecture remain null after exact-model and later-report checks. Document the current snapshot and announced deprecation without conflating them with release timing.
